# MARIGOLD v0.9.3 — "The Skills Pass"

Built by auditing the whole project against the newly installed gamedev agent skills (the Godot 4.7 set + input-systems, game-feel, audio-design, save-systems, dialogue-systems) and applying the fixes that survived review. Full audit: SKILLS_AUDIT_0_9_3.md in the repo.

## PC 2D MENU + ONE-HANDED MOUSE (wade's order, 2026-10-21)
- PC mode now opens a true full-screen 2D menu: clickable list of all 11 chapters with a fixed description panel (no overlap, no clipped names), plus Settings, Check for Updates, Diagnostics and Quit buttons. VR launcher unchanged.
- The whole PC experience works one-handed with just the mouse: hold Left-click = walk, Right-click = teleport, Left-click = use, an on-screen pause button in chapters, and click-adjustable pause/settings throughout.
- This release ships the WINDOWS build only; the v0.9.3 Quest APK follows (blocked on a local build permission, not a code issue).

## INPUT (input-systems + godot-ui-control skills)
- Boot chooser: a gamepad could navigate it but never confirm — pad A now picks (synthetic ui_accept), focus starts on the PC button with a visible focus box.
- Pause: pad B backs out of Settings/Controls pages instead of dropping you out; page switches move focus to the page shown; cycling a setting no longer loses your place (focus restored after the rebuild).
- Teleport confirm is input-buffered (120 ms): a trigger/RT/pinch press just before the petal ring turns valid still fires. teleport_confirm/sprint stick deadzones tightened 0.5 → 0.25.
- PC mode: right-stick look reads ANY connected pad (was hardcoded to pad 0), radial deadzone instead of per-axis, and stick-walk speed is truly analog (was full speed on any tilt).

## AUDIO (godot-audio + audio-design skills)
- A real bus layout now ships: Master (limiter) ← Music / SFX / Ambience / UI / Voice. Dialogue DUCKS the music via a sidechain compressor keyed to the Voice bus.
- New Settings rows: Music / SFX / Voice volume (0–100%, real bus gains, persisted, applied at boot).
- Silent moments got their sounds: teleport petal rustle (laser + pad paths), candle ignitions in the ofrenda finale, the real camera-shutter sample (replaces the two-note chime stand-in) with the haptic owned by snap() itself, pause open/resume/back UI sounds, launcher row haptics.
- One voice at a time — a new line stops the previous instead of talking over it; voice streams are cached; one-shots get slight pitch variation so repeats don't sound stamped; beat phase is latency-compensated.

## GRAPHICS (godot-3d-essentials + shader skills)
- Quest quality tiers are honest now: Ultra falls back to High on Quest, render scale/MSAA capped, and shadows, glow and foveation level actually follow the tier. Sky clouds render in the quarter-resolution pass; the sun is the one shadow-casting light; weather particle counts scale with the tier.

## RELIABILITY (save-systems + dialogue-systems reviews)
- A failed telemetry send RE-QUEUES its batch instead of dropping it — an offline session was exactly the session we never saw. Remote config may only point reports at our own relay host.
- Check for Updates compares the real version code (it was hardcoded to 1 — every check would have claimed an update) and the updater now reports download progress.
- Settings writes are atomic (temp → backup → rename) with a backup fallback on load; the melted-candle registry no longer leaks entries at wax speed ×0.

## TESTS (godot-gdscript-headless-testing skill)
- The ad-hoc probes are now a gate: assertions + exit codes for the input map, all 11 chapters, the 54-line voice cast, the melt system, and a full gamepad end-to-end (chooser → launcher → chapter → pause → settings → back → resume). All green headless.
- NOT Quest-tested yet — wade's first run is the gate. Full notes in CHANGELOG_0_9_3.md.

# MARIGOLD v0.9.2 — "Every Input Works"

## FIXED: the headset could never phone home
- The Quest export preset had the INTERNET permission OFF — telemetry, crash reports, Check for Updates and the launcher's Test Connection could never work on the headset. Zero relay reports explained; on now.
- All relay addresses moved to the current worker (nexus-log-relay.wade-relay.workers.dev); the Godot project still pointed at the retired one in four places.

## FIXED: hand-tracking pinch in chapters
- Chapter pinch and the teleport pinch fallback read the real OpenXR "select_button" action now (the actions they read before don't exist). Pinch registers.
- Hand-aim teleport aims where your hand points (real joint ray) instead of where your head looks.

## NEW: Xbox gamepad support (was: none at all)
- Launcher + pause: D-pad / left stick navigate, A selects, B backs out, Start opens pause — visible focus highlight, auto-scrolling list.
- In chapters: A = interact, RT = teleport confirm; works on a Bluetooth pad in-headset and while streaming via Virtual Desktop.
- PC mode: left stick moves, right stick looks, L3/LT sprint.

## Launcher diagnostics
- New second diag line: gamepad name, last input the menu actually heard (Laser/Pinch/Gaze/Mouse/Gamepad/Keyboard + seconds ago), relay health (host + last send OK/FAILED + time).
- Pause overlay hand pointers use the real XR origin; keyboard navigation (arrows/Tab/Enter) works in launcher + pause on PC.
- NOT Quest-tested yet — wade's first run is the gate. Full notes in CHANGELOG_0_9_2.md.

# MARIGOLD v0.9.1 — "Voices"

## NEW: full voice-over for the Godot script (54 lines, ~5.3 min)
- Every line in the Godot script now plays real audio (was captions-only). The UE5 lines staged in v0.9.0 stay unwired — different cast (Chon/Lalo/Mar don’t exist in this script); a matching Godot-cast set was generated instead.
- Rosa and Tomás keep their exact UE5 voices (Homey Slipper / Restful Raincloud) — one cast across both builds. New original TTS voices for Luz, Xochi, Tlanetl, Mictli, Papalotl, Beto, Chayo, Nena, Rafa, Nico and Moti.
- Honest tradeoff: the TTS catalog has one Spanish-accented female voice (UE5 Mar’s), so Luz/Chayo/Nena use warm English/Caribbean-accented voices.
- Clips sit at the exact paths MarigoldVoice already loads (assets/audio/voice/<chapter>/<speaker>_<key>.wav, mono 48 kHz WAV); captions + caption-only fallback unchanged. Verified headless: 54/54 clips resolve and load; all 11 chapter scenes run with 0 script errors.
- NOT Quest-tested yet — wade’s first run is the gate. Full notes in CHANGELOG_0_9_1.md.

# MARIGOLD v0.7.0 — "The FEEL update"

**Release date:** 2026-10-12 · **11 experiences** · NOT Quest-tested

## NEW: Windows PC VR build (wade's order)
- Marigold-v0.7.0-windows.zip on this release — 64-bit .exe, Forward+ renderer (SDFGI, screen-space reflections, volumetrics on Ultra) for the RTX 5070 Ti, streamed via Virtual Desktop. See VIRTUAL_DESKTOP_SETUP.md. Quest APK remains primary.
- HONEST: no DLSS / no hardware ray tracing in Godot 4. UE5 one-chapter RTX demo approved as a separate workstream (not started).

## Ship-blockers delivered
- PAUSE = flat 2D grid of cards (900x1000, 3 cols, 11 cards, no scroll); panels 100% STATIC, placed once per open.
- SETTINGS one tap from pause: input method, dominant hand, tooltips, graphics Bajo-Ultra (all measurably real).
- LASER TELEPORT in every chapter: aim at ground, marigold-petal ring, trigger teleports.
- Menu button now needs a 0.45s HOLD to pause (ship-pass QA fix); via = menu_hold/exit_button/esc.
- Telemetry: menu_open boot event + immediate flush; BugReporter ported; XR_META_headset_id on.
- Coco-lessons deepening: flight speed curve + arrival beat, progressive ofrenda candles, banda tempo-follow, Mano Magica 10s conducting finale.

## Known limitations
- Ch1 mirror not body-wired; dialogue triggers 41/45 defined, 4 wired; NO voice WAVs (captions fallback); ch5 dance-assist scoring unmodified; seated hip-baseline calibration missing.
